headline: Approved car sales permits at 879 Boston Road and 836 Bay Street; continued 421 Main Street car-lot request.
summary: Car sales permits at 879 Boston Road and 836 Bay Street passed with 12 yes votes each. A drive-up window at 1363 Allen Street and wall signs at 775 Worthington Street and 1150 Hall of Fame Avenue also passed. A fencing rule change and a request to raise the car count at 421 Main Street were both continued to September 28.
decisions: Withdrawn: junk yard special permit request at 383 Rocus Street.
Approved motor vehicle sales as an accessory use at 879 Boston Road, 12-0.
Approved special permit for used car sales at 836 Bay Street, 12-0.
Approved drive-up service window at 1363 Allen Street, et al., 12-0.
Approved accessory wall sign at 775 Worthington Street, 12-0.
Continued request to amend conditions at 421 Main Street to September 28.
Approved accessory wall sign at 1150 Hall of Fame Avenue, 10-0 with two abstentions.
Approved change in petitioner for special permit at 482 & NS Main Street I.O., 11-0 with one abstention.
Continued zone change on fencing rules to September 28, 12-0.

City Council  
     
Regular Meeting 
 
~Final~ 
   
 
36 Court Street  
Springfield, MA 01103   
http://www.springfieldcityhall.com 
 
Gladys Oyola-Lopez 
 
August 24, 2026 6:30 PM City Hall - Room 200 
 
 
 
Roll Call 
COUNCILOR PEREZ WAS ABSENT AND COUNCILORS SANTANEILLO AND HURST 
WERE REMOTE FOR THIS MEETING. 
Moment Of Silence - Pledge Of Allegiance 
 
Special Permits 
 1. 383 Rocus Street - Junk Yard (Withdrawn by petitioner) 
 2. 879 Boston Road - Motor vehicle sales (accessory use) 
OWNER MUHAMMED NOOZARD PRESENTED AND SUBMITTED A LETTER OF 
SUPPORT FROM THE NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL.  COUNCILOR BROWN ASKED IF 
THE BUSINESS WOULD GRANT LOW CREDIT CAR  LOANS.  COUNCILOR CLICK-
BRUCE THANKED THE PETITIONER. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Maria Perez 
 3. 836 Bay Street - Motor Vehicle Sales 
AHMAD SAMAR PRESENTED THE USED CAR DEALERSHIP.  4 CARS ON DISPLAY.
NEED TO UPGRADE WHICH REQUIRES A BUILDING PERMIT THROUGH THE 
SPECIAL PERMIT PROCESS. 
 
COUNCILOR BROWN STATED THE NEIGHBORHOOD APPROVES. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Maria Perez 
 4. 1363 Allen Street, et al. -  Drive Up Service Window 
JEREMY WAKEOUT, REPRESENTATIVE FROM THE ARNCO SIGN COMPANY ON 
BEHALF BEACON BANK SPOKE ON THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
WALTER GOULD, OUTER BELT NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL PRESIDENT SPOKE AND 
SUBMITTED A LIST OF 3 ITEMS TO AMEND THE CONDITIONS.  1. TRIM BACK THE 
BUSHES TO ALLOW VISIBILITY OF ONCOMING TRAFFIC.   PROVIDE A VISUAL 
VIEW OF THE TRAFFIC.  2.  REPAINT THE WORD STOP ON THE ROAD ON THE 
DRIVEWAY EXIT.  3. CREATE A PEDESTRIAN CROSSWALK. COUNCILOR BROWN 
ASKED IF WHETHER THE CITY OF SPRINGFIELD WOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 
THE CREATING A CROSSWALK OR PAINTING THE STOP.  COUNCILOR DAVILA 
MADE NOTE OF THE $200 PER DAY FINE FOR NON-COMPLIANCE. COUNCILOR 
DELGADO ASKED WHY THE BANK WAS NOT PRESENT.  COUNCILOR CLICK-
BRUCE THANKED MR. GOULD FOR BEING PRESENT AND TESTIFYING. 
 COUNCILOR FENTON NOTED THAT MR. WHITCO WAS UNPROFESSIONAL IN HIS 
PRESENTATION AND FOR LEAVING PRIOR TO THE COUNCIL TAKING A VOTE. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Maria Perez
5. 775 Worthington Street - Accessory Wall Sign 
GUNNER MCCORMICK FROM AGNOLI SIGN COMPANY SPOKE ON THE ITEM.   
THE PETITIONER IS SEEKING VISIBILITY FOR THE ADDRESS (FRIENDS OF THE 
HOMELESS). 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Maria Perez 
 6. 421 Main Street & SS Main Street (IO) - Amending Conditions 
THE PETITIONER, ED SHEVETSOV PRESENTED A LETTER OF SUPPORT FROM THE 
INDIAN ORCHARD CITIZENS COUNCIL.  ASKING FOR MORE CARS.  HE OUTLINED 
THAT HE HAS BEEN IN BUSINESS FOR 25 YEARS.  WOULD LIKE TO GO FROM 20 
CARS TO 60 CARS.  HE HAS HIRED AN ARCHITECT.  HE TRIED IN 2017, AND 
EXPIRED.  HE IS RE-APPLYING TO GROW HIS BUSINESS.  COUNCILOR GOVAN 
STATED THE PETIOTIONER HAD MANY SUPPORTERS AND THE NEIGHBORHOOD 
SUPPORTS BECAUSE HE HAS THE PROPERTY.  PHIL DROMEY STATED THAT THIS 
PROPERTY HAS BEEN IN VIOLATION FOR 26 YEARS.  COUNCILOR EDWARDS 
VOCALIZED HIS OPPOSITION.  STATED THERE IS NO MECHANISIM IN PLACE TO 
REVOKE SPECIAL PERMITS.  THE CITY IS NOW ENFORCING DUMPSTER CLOSURE. 
 THE BURDEN CAN'T CONTINUE TO BE ON THE CITY.  PETITIONERS NEED TO BE 
HELD ACCOUNTABLE.   
 
COUNCILOR BROWN SPOKE ON THE MOTION TO RE-OPEN.  HE WOULD SUPPORT 
THE INCREASE BUT NOTED THE OPPORTUNITY FOR FURTHER DISCUSSION.   
 
COUNCILOR DAVILA NOTED HIS CONCERNS SPECIFICALLY THE VIOLATIONS OF 
THE EXISTING SPECIAL PERMIT 
THE PETITIONER RESPONDED.  NO DUMPSTER.  HE HAS ONLY HAD BARRELS.  3 
BARRELS THAT ARE PICKED UP BY THE CITY.  THE PETITIONER PRESENTED A 
LETTER THAT SPECIFIED HE HAS THE RIGHT TO HAVE 30 CARS ON THE LOT.   
 
COUNCILOR BROWN SUGGESTED A MOVE TO COMMITTEE FOR FURTHER 
DISCUSSION.  
COUNCILOR FENTON ASKED THE PETITIONER OF THE CURRENT STATUS OF THE
EXISTING CODE ENFORCEMENT COMPLAINTS.  THE PETITIONER SAID THAT HE IS 
IN COMPLIANCE. PHIL DROMEY NOTED THAT THE PERMIT HAS ALWAYS BEEN 20 
CARS AND NOTED THAT MIKE JACHYM DOES NOT HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO 
ALLOW FOR 30 CARS WITHOUT AN AMENDMENT OF THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
 COUNCILOR FENTON THAT HE WILL SUPPORT THE MOTION TO COMMITTEE. 
 COUNCILOR DELGADO NOTED THAT SOME OF THE ENFORCEMENT ISSUES ARE A 
CITY RESPONSIBILITY AND ASKED A FOR CLARIFICATION OF WHAT HAPPENS IF 
A BUSINESS IS IN VIOLATION.  WHEN DOES THE CITY COUNCIL GET NOTIFIED?   
COUNCILOR BROWN SUGGESTED A MONTHLY REPORT OF BUSINESSES FROM 
CODE ENFORCEMENT. 
THIS ITEM HAS BEEN CONTINUED TO SEPTEMBER 28TH HEARINGS MEETING. 
 7. 1150 Hall of Fame Avenue - Accessory Wall Sign 
ATTORNEY RACHEL FANCY OF FITZGERALD LAW FOR BEACON ABA SERVICE.   
SRA APPROVED THE SIGN AS WELL AS THE NEIGHBORHOOD COUNCIL. 
 
AYES Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh, Victor 
Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin

 8. 482 & NS Main Street I.O. - Change in Petitioner  
MR ARSHIK SAMAD PRESENTED THE CHANGE.  WILL COMPLY WIH ALL 
CONDITIONS FOR THE SPECIAL PERMIT. 
 
AYES Gerry Martin, Malo Brown, Zaida Govan, Kateri Walsh, Justin Hurst, 
Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, Lavar Click-Bruce, 
Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN Brian Santaniello 
ABSENT Maria Perez

COUNCILOR MARTIN ASKED FOR THIS ZONE CHANGE BE CONTINUED UNTIL 9/28
